description: ALL THREE in one gateway, no switching: local Ollama models (CPU PC) + hosted/nemotron-nano-reasoning (OpenRouter free, public-api) + bedrock/nemotron-nano-3-30b (AWS Bedrock Sydney, private-cloud). chainaim/auto and health data stay local (--auto-zones local --phi-zones local); a hosted model answers only when named. Asks for OPENROUTER_API_KEY and BEDROCK_API_KEY (hidden). Run -To ollama-cpu-8gb once first if the Qwen variants are missing.
doneMessage: Local + OpenRouter + Bedrock are on in one gateway. Name a model to use it: local/qwen2.5-3b, hosted/nemotron-nano-reasoning, bedrock/nemotron-nano-3-30b (chainaim/auto stays local). Console: node test-console\console\server.ts --models-file config\local-models.cpu-all.json
